import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lit, round as spark_round, sqrt
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, DoubleType

# MAGIC %python
# MAGIC 
# MAGIC # Define the schema for requests and profiles
requests_schema = StructType([
    StructField("request_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("account_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("request_lat", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("request_lon", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("requested_at", StringType(), True)
])

profiles_schema = StructType([
    StructField("account_id", StringType(), True),
    StructField("home_lat", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("home_lon", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("base_score", DoubleType(), True)
])

# MAGIC %python
# MAGIC 
# MAGIC # Read CSV files
requests_df = spark.read.csv("/Workspace/Users/benedict@hopsworks.ai/mlpab545541/data/requests.csv", header=True, schema=requests_schema)
profiles_df = spark.read.csv("/Workspace/Users/benedict@hopsworks.ai/mlpab545541/data/profiles.csv", header=True, schema=profiles_schema)

# MAGIC %python
# MAGIC 
# MAGIC # Join requests with profiles on account_id
joined_df = requests_df.join(profiles_df, "account_id", "inner")

# MAGIC %python
# MAGIC 
# MAGIC # Compute distance_deg and score
from pyspark.sql.functions import pow

distance_df = joined_df.withColumn(
    "distance_deg", 
    spark_round(
        sqrt(pow(col("request_lat") - col("home_lat"), 2) + pow(col("request_lon") - col("home_lon"), 2)),
        6
    )
)

score_df = distance_df.withColumn(
    "score",
    spark_round(col("base_score") - 0.1 * col("distance_deg"), 6)
)

# MAGIC %python
# MAGIC 
# MAGIC # Select the required columns
result_df = score_df.select("request_id", "account_id", "distance_deg", "score")

# MAGIC %python
# MAGIC 
# MAGIC # Write to Unity Catalog table
result_df.write.mode("overwrite").saveAsTable("workspace.mlpab545541.scored68393f")
